Xcoord, Ycoord, size, collection, cycles)) %>% arrange(microsample) #write.table(mssm_sample_metadata, "data/mssm_sample_metadata.tsv") #mssm_sample_metadata <- read.table("data/mssm_sample_metadata.tsv") 2.2 Sequencing Data Quality 2.2.1 Read Quality: Pre- vs Post-Filtering (fastp) Note: The parse_fastp() function in index needs to be loaded. mssm_json_data <- fromJSON("data/multiqc_data.json") # Download file from ERDA mssm_fastp <- parse_fastp(mssm_json_data) %>% rename_with(~ gsub("^(summary|filtering_result|adapter_cutting|polyx_trimming)\\.", "", .)) %>% select( sample_id, before_filtering.total_reads, after_filtering.total_reads, before_filtering.total_bases, after_filtering.total_bases, before_filtering.gc_content, after_filtering.gc_content, low_quality_reads, adapter_trimmed_reads, adapter_trimmed_bases, duplication.rate ) %>% mutate(microsample = str_remove(sample_id, "\\.lib\\d+$")) %>% filter(grepl("^M", microsample)) %>% group_by(microsample) %>% summarise( across(contains("reads"), sum, .names = "total_{.col}"), across(contains("bases"), sum, .names = "total_{.col}"), across(ends_with("content"), mean, .names = "percent_{.col}"), across(ends_with("rate"), mean, .names = "percent_{.col}") ) 2.2.2 Contamination Assessment: Host, Human, and Environmental Reads mssm_euk_mapping <- read_tsv("https://sid.erda.dk/share_redirect/aTWbNfAf1o/results/preprocess_bowtie2_multiqc_report_data/multiqc_samtools_stats.txt") %>% mutate( reference = case_when( grepl("GRCh38", Sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "human", grepl("GRCg7b", Sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "chicken", grepl("Sscrofa11.1", Sample, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "pig", TRUE ~ NA_character_ ), microsample = str_extract(Sample, "M\\d+") ) %>% filter( !is.na(reference), # Remove rows where reference is NA grepl("^M", microsample) ) %>% select(Sample, microsample, reference, raw_total_sequences, reads_mapped, reads_unmapped) %>% group_by(microsample, reference) %>% summarise( raw_total_sequences = sum(raw_total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE), reads_mapped = sum(reads_mapped, na.rm = TRUE), reads_unmapped = sum(reads_unmapped, na.rm = TRUE) ) %>% pivot_wider(names_from = reference, values_from = c(raw_total_sequences, reads_mapped, reads_unmapped)) 2.2.3 Genome-Centric Mapping Statistics: Macroscale MAG Catalogue # download.file("https://sid.erda.dk/share_redirect/aTWbNfAf1o/results/quantify.zip", "data/quantify.zip", mode = "wb") mssm_mag_mapping <- read.table(unz("data/quantify.zip", "multiqc_samtools_stats.txt"), header = T, sep = "\t", quote = "\"") %>% mutate(microsample = str_extract(Sample, "M\\d+")) %>% filter(grepl("^M", microsample)) %>% select(Sample, microsample, raw_total_sequences, reads_mapped, reads_unmapped) %>% group_by(microsample) %>% summarise( raw_total_sequences_mag = sum(raw_total_sequences, na.rm = TRUE), reads_mapped_mag = sum(reads_mapped, na.rm = TRUE), reads_unmapped_mag = sum(reads_unmapped, na.rm = TRUE) ) 2.2.4 Read-Centric Mapping Statistics: Kraken (genomes) and SingleM (single-copy marker genes) mssm_singlem <- read_tsv("https://sid.erda.dk/share_redirect/aTWbNfAf1o/results/preprocess/singlem/microbial_fraction.tsv") %>% mutate(microsample = str_extract(sample, "M\\d+")) %>% filter(grepl("^M", microsample)) %>% select(-c(warning, sample)) %>% group_by(microsample) %>% summarise( read_fraction_singlem = (mean(read_fraction, na.rm = TRUE)) / 100 #, # bacterial_archaeal_bases_singlem = sum(bacterial_archaeal_bases, na.rm = TRUE), # average_bacterial_archaeal_genome_size_singlem = mean(average_bacterial_archaeal_genome_size, na.rm = TRUE) ) mssm_kraken <- read_tsv("https://sid.erda.dk/share_redirect/aTWbNfAf1o/results/preprocess_kraken2_multiqc_report_data/multiqc_kraken.txt") %>% mutate(microsample = str_extract(Sample, "M\\d+")) %>% filter(grepl("^M", microsample)) %>% select(Sample, microsample, D) %>% separate(D, into = c("Eukaryota", "Bacteria", "Archaea", "Viruses"), sep = ", ", remove = TRUE) %>% mutate(across(!all_of("microsample"), ~ parse_number(.))) %>% group_by(microsample) %>% summarise( kr_Eukaryota = sum(Eukaryota, na.rm = TRUE), kr_Bacteria = sum(Bacteria, na.rm = TRUE), kr_Archaea = sum(Archaea, na.rm = TRUE), kr_Viruses = sum(Viruses, na.rm = TRUE), ) %>% mutate( total_kraken = kr_Eukaryota + kr_Bacteria + kr_Archaea + kr_Viruses, bacteria_pct_kraken = kr_Bacteria / total_kraken, eukaryota_pct_kraken = kr_Eukaryota / total_kraken ) 2.2.5 Redundancy & Coverage Estimation: Nonpareil mssm_nonpareil <- read_tsv("https://sid.erda.dk/share_redirect/aTWbNfAf1o/results/preprocess_nonpareil_multiqc_report_data/nonpareil-table.txt") %>% mutate(microsample = str_extract(Sample, "M\\d+")) %>% filter(grepl("^M", microsample)) %>% select(microsample, Redundancy, Coverage, Diversity) %>% group_by(microsample) %>% summarise( redundancy_nonpareil = (mean(Redundancy, na.rm = TRUE)) / 100, coverage_nonpareil = (mean(Coverage, na.rm = TRUE)) / 100, diversity_nonpareil = mean(Diversity, na.rm = TRUE) ) 2.2.6 Combined Quality Statistics mssm_quality <- reduce( list( mssm_sample_metadata, mssm_fastp, mssm_euk_mapping, mssm_mag_mapping, mssm_singlem, mssm_kraken, mssm_nonpareil ), full_join, by = "microsample" ) %>% mutate( lowquality_reads_pct = ((total_before_filtering.total_reads - total_after_filtering.total_reads) / total_before_filtering.total_reads), adapter_contamination_pct = (total_adapter_trimmed_bases / total_before_filtering.total_bases), host_pct = (reads_mapped_chicken / total_before_filtering.total_reads), human_pct = (reads_mapped_human / total_before_filtering.total_reads), pig_pct = (reads_mapped_pig / total_before_filtering.total_reads), prokreads_pct = (raw_total_sequences_mag / total_before_filtering.total_reads), mapmag_rawreads_pct = (reads_mapped_mag / total_before_filtering.total_reads), mapmag_filteredreads_pct = (reads_mapped_mag / total_after_filtering.total_reads), mapmag_prokreads_pct = (reads_mapped_mag / raw_total_sequences_mag) ) %>% filter(microsample %in% c(mssm_sample_metadata$microsample))
